Reason: The provided image is an endoscopic view (not a chest X-ray) showing a small, white foreign body lodged in a bronchial opening, which corresponds to the description of a small object detected in the right hilum without gross radiographic signs like atelectasis or air trapping on a standard X-ray. This presentation is characteristic of a clinically occult aspiration where the object is visible via bronchoscopy but may be missed or appear subtle on plain film.
